cars.summary: The G29 M40i restored a fabric roof and a more agile chassis to BMW’s straight-six roadster tradition. Contemporary production-car driving praised its engine, steering and composure. Its substantive chassis redesign and six-cylinder sporting character justify one new Z4 generation, rather than extra counts for later packages.

cars.specification_market: Mercedes-Benz Netherlands announcement dated 21 August 2011 for Frankfurt unveiling; 2011 is the selected announcement reference, not a guessed local delivery date or US model year. Preserve native kW and Nm. AMG Handling Package, limited-slip differential and composite front brakes are optional. Brake-based torque vectoring is not a standard mechanical limited-slip differential. Do not transfer R171 figures or later SLC 43 turbo V6 hardware.
cars.summary: The third-generation SLK 55 AMG kept a naturally aspirated V8 in a compact sporting roadster while adding cylinder deactivation and direct injection. This unusual combination preserves a distinctive AMG engineering chapter beyond the archived R171; the subsequent SLC rename does not create another generation.
